read: 2026-10-08, by eye from the cached schematic image
comment: Hand-drawn 600x460 scan of a large analog delay line (555/7474/MN3002 clock, several BBD stages with 24dB and 36dB filters, reverb and echo sums, mains supply). At this resolution most of the BBD-section values and all IC part numbers on the signal path are illegible, and there are no designators, so no parts list could be read reliably.
